source: OFFICIAL: TSPI-AI Clinical Decision Engine.pdf v3.0 + question_answers.txt Q5

nss_scale.driver: inflammatory network activity (NF-kB, IL-6, TNF-a, COX-2, NLRP3, ROS)

ks_protocol.rule: KS dosed by bowel performance, NOT severity level
ks_protocol.goal: minimum 2 comfortable bowel movements/day; complete evacuation, no straining/bloating

start.incomplete_evacuation: 2 caps before bed + 2 caps on waking
start.chronic_constipation: 4 caps before bed + 2 caps on waking

ks_protocol.titration: increase 2 caps every 3-7 days until bowel target met
ks_protocol.practical_max: 8 caps before bed + 4 caps on waking (12/day); physician review beyond

safety: TSPI-AI is a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS). It recommends modules, dosing ranges, and priorities; final prescribing authority remains with the supervising physician.

bowel_protocol.rule: Bowel-regulation modules are dosed by bowel performance, NOT the severity level.
bowel_protocol.goal: minimum 2 comfortable bowel movements/day; complete evacuation, no straining/bloating
bowel_protocol.generic_dose: 1-4 capsules before bedtime and again on waking, titrated to the patient's bowel condition
bowel_protocol.note: KS has its own detailed titration (see ks_protocol); other bowel modules use the generic dose.
